posts.post_content: The original bronze 'Dancing Girl' statuette of Mohenjo-daro is housed in which museum?

meta_input._aimcq_explanation:
Correct Answer: National Museum, New Delhi

The original Dancing Girl is in the National Museum, New Delhi.

Correct Option Explanation

The statuette, about 10.5 cm tall, was found at Mohenjo-daro in the 1920s and passed to India after the division of finds following 1947.

Incorrect Options Analysis
  • Indian Museum, Kolkata: Wrong. It is India's oldest museum (1814) but does not hold this statuette.
  • National Museum, Karachi: Wrong. It holds the Priest-King bust, not the Dancing Girl.
  • Prince of Wales Museum, Mumbai: Wrong. It does not hold the original statuette.
Know More
  • The Priest-King steatite bust is in the National Museum of Pakistan, Karachi.
  • The Dancing Girl shows a nude figure with bangles on one arm and a necklace.
  • Artefacts from Harappan sites were divided between India and Pakistan after Partition.
  • The Great Bath remains in situ at Mohenjo-daro.
meta_input._aimcq_title_hi: मोहनजोदड़ो की मूल कांस्य 'नर्तकी' प्रतिमा कि…
meta_input._aimcq_question_content_hi: मोहनजोदड़ो की मूल कांस्य 'नर्तकी' प्रतिमा किस संग्रहालय में रखी है?
meta_input._aimcq_explanation_hi:
सही उत्तर: राष्ट्रीय संग्रहालय, नई दिल्ली

मूल नर्तकी प्रतिमा राष्ट्रीय संग्रहालय, नई दिल्ली में है।

सही विकल्प की व्याख्या

लगभग 10.5 सेमी ऊँची यह प्रतिमा 1920 के दशक में मोहनजोदड़ो से मिली और 1947 के बाद प्राप्तियों के विभाजन में भारत के पास आई।

गलत विकल्पों का विश्लेषण
  • भारतीय संग्रहालय, कोलकाता: गलत। यह भारत का सबसे पुराना संग्रहालय (1814) है, पर इस प्रतिमा का संग्रह इसमें नहीं है।
  • राष्ट्रीय संग्रहालय, कराची: गलत। इसमें पुरोहित-राजा की प्रतिमा है, नर्तकी नहीं।
  • प्रिंस ऑफ वेल्स संग्रहालय, मुंबई: गलत। इसमें मूल प्रतिमा नहीं है।
और जानें
  • पुरोहित-राजा की सेलखड़ी प्रतिमा पाकिस्तान के राष्ट्रीय संग्रहालय, कराची में है।
  • नर्तकी की नग्न आकृति की एक भुजा में चूड़ियाँ और गले में हार दिखाया गया है।
  • विभाजन के बाद हड़प्पाई स्थलों की प्राप्तियाँ भारत और पाकिस्तान में बाँटी गईं।
  • विशाल स्नानागार मोहनजोदड़ो में अपने मूल स्थान पर है।

posts.post_content:
Arrange the following Harappan sites in the order in which their major excavation began.

  1. Surkotada
  2. Kalibangan
  3. Ropar
  4. Alamgirpur

Select the correct answer from the code given below:

meta_input._aimcq_explanation:
Correct Answer: 3, 4, 2, 1

Ropar (3) → Alamgirpur (4) → Kalibangan (2) → Surkotada (1).

Correct Option Explanation
  • Ropar: Y.D. Sharma, 1953–56.
  • Alamgirpur: Y.D. Sharma, 1958–59.
  • Kalibangan: B.B. Lal and B.K. Thapar, 1960–69.
  • Surkotada: J.P. Joshi, 1971–72.
Incorrect Options Analysis
  • 3, 2, 4, 1: Wrong. Alamgirpur was dug before Kalibangan.
  • 4, 3, 2, 1: Wrong. Ropar was dug before Alamgirpur.
  • 3, 4, 1, 2: Wrong. Surkotada's excavation came after Kalibangan's.
Know More
  • Surkotada had its citadel and residential annex inside a single fortification.
  • Surkotada was discovered by J.P. Joshi in 1964.
  • Kalibangan's Early Harappan phase is called Sothi.
  • Alamgirpur is the easternmost Harappan site.

  • कालीबंगा के प्रारंभिक हड़प्पा चरण को सोथी कहते हैं।

posts.post_title: Which of the following statements about the…
posts.post_content:
Which of the following statements about the Harappan economy is/are correct?

  1. The Harappans used standardised weights and measures.
  2. Lapis lazuli used by the Harappans was imported from Afghanistan.
  3. Cotton was cultivated and spun into textiles.
  4. Domesticated horses were widely used to draw Harappan carts.

Select the correct answer from the code given below:

meta_input._aimcq_explanation:
Correct Answer: Only 1, 2 and 3

Statements 1, 2 and 3 are correct; statement 4 is wrong.

Correct Option Explanation
  • Weights followed a regular system and were uniform across sites.
  • Lapis lazuli came from Badakhshan, Afghanistan.
  • Cotton cloth traces and spindle whorls are known.
  • Carts were drawn by oxen; clear evidence of domesticated horses is lacking.
Incorrect Options Analysis
  • Only 1, 2 and 4: Wrong. Statement 4 is false and statement 3 is omitted.
  • Only 2, 3 and 4: Wrong. Statement 4 is false and statement 1 is omitted.
  • All of the above: Wrong. Statement 4 is false.
Know More
  • Clay models of bullock carts are common finds.
  • Shortugai was a Harappan outpost linked to lapis lazuli.
  • Mohenjo-daro yielded madder-dyed cotton fragments.
  • The horse is absent from Harappan seals.

  • केवल 2, 3 और 4: गलत। कथन 4 असत्य है और कथन 1 छूट गया है।

posts.post_content: The granary complex found at Harappa by Wheeler was arranged in which manner?

_aimcq_options.text: A single block of twelve halls
Two rows of six units each
Three rows of four units each
Four rows of three units each

meta_input._aimcq_explanation:
Correct Answer: Two rows of six units each

The Harappa granaries stood in two rows of six units.

Correct Option Explanation

Twelve brick-built units, each about 15 × 6 m, were raised on platforms with air channels for ventilation. They lay near the citadel mound, close to the river-side.

Incorrect Options Analysis
  • A single block of twelve halls: Wrong. The units were split into two parallel rows.
  • Three rows of four units each: Wrong. The arrangement was two rows, not three.
  • Four rows of three units each: Wrong. The arrangement was two rows, not four.
Know More
  • Nearby were circular brick platforms used to thresh and pound grain.
  • Charred wheat and barley chaff was found in their hollows.
  • Mohenjo-daro's Great Granary was the largest building of its citadel.
  • Wheeler's Harappa excavation took place in 1946.

सही विकल्प की व्याख्या

शैफर के चार चरण हैं: प्रारंभिक खाद्य-उत्पादक, क्षेत्रीयकरण, एकीकरण (लगभग 2600–1900 ई.पू.) और स्थानीयकरण। एकीकरण युग साझा मुहरों, बाटों और ईंटों वाली एकीकृत नगरीय संस्कृति का चरण है।

  • क्षेत्रीयकरण युग: गलत। यह क्षेत्रीय संस्कृतियों वाला प्रारंभिक हड़प्पा चरण है।
